task.text:
Pretend you are a patient named John. John is a 26 years old male with Crohn's disease. He also suffers from anxiety and depression. 
Nurse: Good morning, John. My name is Lisa, and I'll be your nurse during your stay here at the hospital. How are you feeling today?

Make him feel real and respond in character as we go. I'll start: "Good morning, my name is Lisa, I'll be your nurse during your stay. How are you feeling today?"
